subject: Offline review of the feature 015 benchmark packages for the ST USART and GPIO LL drivers (STM32CubeN6 v1.4.0, FROZEN)
statement: USART and GPIO reviewed and approved
decision: The owner reviewed the two READY_FOR_OFFLINE_REVIEW packages below and approved them. The approval is bound to each sealed archive by its SHA-256; any other archive of these work orders is not covered. The GPIO package states owner disposition OD-2026-10-26-01 (out-of-contract pin for LL_GPIO_SetAFPin_8_15) as a limitation.
not_changed: No safety approval, ASPICE/ISO 26262 compliance or certification claim; the delivered ST code is unchanged (FROZEN); the signed SSA-STB-001/TAA-STB-001 and their open findings stand; TIM is not covered.
